column6:
Are you an Example College student or alum?

NOTE: Example Makers Fair is for Example College students, alumni and staff.

We may ask to see a student or staff card at the door.
column7: Please provide your Example College email address (alumni and staff may give the one the college issued to them).
column8: If you do not have an Example College email, please upload proof that you belong to Example College (a timetable, an alumni card or a staff card).
column9:
Discord Username

We share table numbers and news on the day through the fair's Discord server.

(your username, not your display name)
column11: Where can we find your business online? (one link)
column12: Have you had a table at a market or fair before?
column13: What are you planning to sell?
column14:
Please share a link to your portfolio or to photos of the pieces you plan to bring to Example Makers Fair. A website, a social page or a shared folder all work.

If your portfolio is private, please let anyone with the link view it until applications close.
column15:
I certify that everything I will sell at the fair is designed and made by me, and that I have the right to sell it.

Resold goods, dropshipped goods and work traced from another artist are not allowed. Fan art is welcome as long as the drawing is my own, but I will not sell copies of official merchandise.

If the team finds work at my table that breaks this rule, they may ask me to take it down or to leave the fair, and I may not be offered a table next time.
column16:
I certify that the work I will sell follows the fair's content rules, posted at https://example.com/fair-rules.

Example Hall is a public building and families walk through the fair, so:
- No work showing graphic violence or sexual content.
- No work that targets a person or a group of people.
- Work for an older audience is kept in a closed binder, and I will ask for ID before showing it.

If I am not sure whether a piece is allowed, I will message the team on Discord before the fair, and I understand the team may ask me to take down a piece that breaks these rules.
column17: Which of these clubs are you in?
column18: If you ticked a club, please upload something that shows you are a member.
column19:
For each day, choose every table tier you would take. Choose None for a day you cannot attend.

NOTE:
- Gold tables are in the North Wing of Example Hall, Silver tables in the South Wing and Bronze tables in the lobby; Bronze costs the least.
- Each vendor is given a table on up to 2 days in total, even if you choose more.
- We will never place you on a day you left at None, or at a tier you did not choose.

Choosing more tiers and days makes it more likely we can find you a table. [Monday, May 19th]

column24:
Which table size would you like, a half table or full table? Tick all that suit you.

- A full table is about two metres wide; a half table is half of one, at half the fee.
- Half tables are shared with another vendor.
- Either means you are happy with whichever we have room for.
- Your choice cannot change after results are out.
column25:
If you chose a half table or Either, who would you like to share a table with?

Please give your partner's email address, as they wrote it on their own application.

NOTE:
- You and your partner must each apply.
- Your partner must also choose a half table or Either.
- Leave this blank and we will pair you with another vendor where we can.
- We try to keep every pair together, but cannot promise it.
